Crafton Hills College welcomed more than 40 veterans and military-affiliated job seekers
to its Veterans Job & Resource Fair on September 30, connecting attendees with employment
opportunities, career training, and valuable community resources. Held at the Barbara
L. Smith Event Center in partnership with the Redlands Chamber of Commerce, the event
brought together more than 30 employers and community organizations committed to supporting

excerpts.line: about educational opportunities, employment assistance, healthcare, and veteran services.
window: San Bernardino County Sheriff's Department, Loma Linda University Health, CarMax,
and Allied Universal Security Services. Resource providers, including CalVet, U.S.VETS,
VA Loma Linda Healthcare System, and the San Bernardino Vet Center, shared information
about educational opportunities, employment assistance, healthcare, and veteran services.

and employers who recognize the valuable skills and experience military service brings
